{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print(f"Total rows: {len(trial)}")
print(f"Unique patient_id: {trial['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"Duplicate patient_id count: {len(trial) - trial['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Check sample_seq to see if higher sample_seq means newer test
print(f"Max sample_seq per patient:")
print(trial.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max().describe())

# Confirm that the highest sample_seq row should be kept
# Show a few examples of duplicate patients
duplicate_patients = trial[trial['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)]
print(f"\nExamples of duplicate patients:")
print(duplicate_patients[['patient_id', 'sample_seq', 'arm', 'severity', 'biomarker_baseline', 'biomarker_final', 'responded']].sort_values(['patient_id', 'sample_seq']).head(10))"}
